items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: I tell you, I tell you a fella play in the band with him... His name is... Happy, yeah. Goldston.

ctx.x: We were talking yesterday. Yeah. That was just lately you heard that, you mean? Well, I tell you, I tell you a fella play in the band with him. He lived right there in the last, last gate, uh, Arnt Fence. That's his home there. His name was, he's a drummer. His name is... Oh, uh, Happy, uh... Happy, yeah. Goldston. Oh, Goldston, yeah.
